blocks.text: Sept. 27, 2026 | U.K. police arrest 5 men suspected of plotting a terror attack on an airbase used by the U.S. to strike Iran. A U.S. import ban on certain Canadian goods looms. And, CBC News is in Kyiv witnessing Russia’s relentless bombardments.
